description: Unattended mode: no pull requests, no issues. Updates are tested on a renovate/* branch (CI build + smoke test) and fast-forwarded into main on success.

packageRules.description: Image contents (Caddy + bouncer): patch, minor and digest updates are merged automatically after a green CI build
Major updates of the image contents (e.g. Caddy 3) are not applied automatically
GitHub Actions: merged automatically after a green CI build (the CI run on the branch uses the new action versions)
